outcome: preterm delivery (prior to 35 weeks of gestation)
cohort: The study included 167 women with twin gestations and a cervical length of <=2.5 cm, who delivered at a tertiary-care medical centre in New York City between 2010 and 2013.
finding: After correcting for confounding using propensity score methods, vaginal progesterone therapy in twin pregnancies with a cervical length <=2.5 cm was associated with an increased risk of preterm delivery prior to 35 weeks of gestation.
followup_time: Until delivery or 35 weeks of gestation (whichever came first for the outcome)
gest_age: Inclusion: 16-32 weeks gestation; Outcome: prior to 35 weeks gestation
